absurdista.name: The Absurdist
absurdista.instructions: Give a 90-second TED Talk defending this absurd idea. Include a trait or anecdote about your opponent in your argument.

atlasOfMe.name: Atlas of Me
atlasOfMe.instructions: Share a memory or personal experience related to this place. Your opponent will rate how strong the connection is.

dilemma.name: The Dilemma
dilemma.instructions: Present an impossible choice. Your opponent must choose one and explain why their principles led them there.
